Dehydrated Coriander Leaves Powder for B2B Food Manufacturing

Dehydrated coriander leaves powder is a shelf-stable green herb ingredient made from carefully selected coriander (cilantro) leaves. It is dried and milled to keep the herb's typical aroma, green colour and savoury, slightly citrus flavour. Tradenest Naturals supplies it to food manufacturers, spice blenders, foodservice operators, importers, private label brands and wholesale distributors who need the same result batch after batch. As a dehydrated coriander leaves powder supplier and dehydrated coriander leaves powder exporter from India, we offer a standard grade and can work to customer specifications for domestic and overseas markets. The powder is made for production settings where fresh coriander is hard to source, store, portion or standardise. It blends into dry seasoning mixes, spice systems, instant food lines, snack coatings, bakery goods and ready-to-cook products. Bulk dehydrated coriander leaves powder is available in a range of commercial pack formats, depending on order volume, stock and your specification. B2B buyers can contact Tradenest Naturals directly for samples, the product specification sheet, private label discussions or export quotations.

Product Overview and Characteristics

The powder is produced by cleaning and drying coriander leaves under controlled conditions, then grinding and sieving them. Drying lowers the moisture content considerably while keeping the sensory character of the herb. Compared with fresh coriander, the dried format is easier to handle, simpler to store, easier to portion and lasts far longer when packed and stored properly. The finished product is a free-flowing green to greenish-brown powder with a fresh, herbal coriander aroma. Flavour strength can vary a little with the crop, harvest season, leaf maturity, drying conditions and particle size. Tradenest Naturals keeps batches consistent through careful raw material selection, process controls, sieving, inspection and traceability. Many buyers use the powder alongside, or instead of, coriander seed powder. The two taste quite different. Seed powder is warm, nutty and slightly sweet, while leaf powder gives the bright, green, herbal note of fresh cilantro. If your recipe calls for fresh coriander leaves at the end of cooking, leaf powder is usually the closer match. We are happy to send samples of the standard grade so your development team can compare it against your current ingredient.

Manufacturing and Processing Methodology

Coriander leaves are bought through approved supply channels from trusted growers and inspected on arrival. The leaves are sorted to remove foreign matter and unsuitable plant material, then cleaned using standard food-processing practices. Controlled dehydration brings the moisture down to a stable level suited to fine milling and storage. The dried leaves are then milled and passed through a calibrated sieve to reach the agreed particle size.
  • Raw material selection and receiving inspection
  • Sorting and removal of foreign matter
  • Hygienic cleaning and controlled dehydration
  • Fine grinding to the required powder grade
  • Calibrated sieving for consistent particle size
  • Batch inspection, secure packing, labelling and traceability
The standard product contains no additives unless a customer-approved formulation says otherwise. Any custom blends or special packaging are reviewed and confirmed with you before commercial production. Because the leaves are delicate, drying conditions matter. Too much heat dulls the colour and drives off aroma, while too little leaves moisture that can cause caking later. Our team watches temperature and drying time closely so that the finished powder keeps a good green shade and a clean herbal smell.

Typical Technical Specifications

Typical commercial values are listed below for product planning and R&D. Final parameters can vary with the agreed grade, destination-market rules, raw material season and any customer quality agreement. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation.
  • Mesh Size: 60-100 mesh.
  • Moisture Content: Not more than 7%.
  • Purity: Single-ingredient coriander leaf powder, sorted and sieved to the agreed specification.
  • Appearance: Fine powder, green to greenish-brown.
  • Flavor Profile: Typical coriander leaf taste: fresh, herbal and mildly citrus-like.
  • Additives: No added colours, preservatives or fillers in the standard product unless agreed in writing.
Residue limits, allergen declarations and other quality parameters can be agreed according to the buyer's technical needs and the rules of the destination country. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Quality Assurance, Compliance, and Documentation

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business. Our documented food safety and quality routines cover raw material inspection, moisture control, hygienic handling, batch identification, in-process checks, packing checks and finished product review. Every shipment leaves with traceability information and labelling that matches the purchase order. As an IEC registered exporter, we offer export documentation support, which normally includes the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin and any other papers required by the buyer or destination market. We do not claim certifications beyond our FSSAI licence and IEC registration. Please let us know during the quotation stage if you need specific declarations, audits, test reports or regulatory documents, so we can confirm what is possible before production.

Industrial Applications

As a dried coriander leaf supplier, we see the powder used wherever a formulation needs dependable herb flavour in a convenient dry form. Main applications include:
  • Seasoning blends, dry spice mixes, curry powders and instant masala systems
  • Instant soups, noodle seasonings, sauces, gravies, dips and ready-to-cook meals
  • Snack coatings, namkeen, extruded snacks and fried snack seasonings
  • Chutney powders, dry herb mixes, marinades and culinary premixes
  • Savoury bakery products such as crackers, breads and savoury biscuits
  • Foodservice kitchens, restaurants, hotels, cloud kitchens and QSR (Quick Service Restaurant) food preparation
  • Private label herb packs and retail spice packaging
  • Custom seasoning blends and specialised food ingredient formulations
The right dosage depends on the flavour strength you want, the type of product, your processing conditions and what other herbs or spices are present. We recommend plant trials before scaling up, especially for high-temperature cooking, wet processing or products with a tightly defined colour and aroma profile. As a rough guide, leaf powder is often added late in cooking or in dry blends that are not heated, because long, high heat softens the fresh herbal note.

B2B Buyer Value Proposition

  • Enhanced Operational Convenience: A ready-to-use dry powder removes the washing, chopping and preparation that fresh herbs need.
  • Extended Storage Potential: Low moisture and protective packaging give a much longer shelf life than fresh coriander.
  • Cost and Process Efficiency: Dry dosing makes inventory planning easier, cuts labour and gives accurate portion control.
  • Consistent Formulation Performance: A clearly defined powder grade supports repeatable blending and predictable production.
  • Mitigated Seasonal Dependence: A shelf-stable format shields your supply chain from fresh coriander price spikes and shortages.
  • Flexible Sourcing Solutions: A range of pack sizes and private label formats suits different business models.

Packaging Formats and Shelf Life

Packaging is chosen to protect the powder from moisture, contamination, light and physical damage in storage and international transit. Formats include food-grade stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, lined corrugated cartons and multi-wall export bulk bags. Inner liners and outer packaging can be adjusted to suit order size, transport mode, warehouse conditions and customer needs. Shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date when the powder is packed in suitable moisture-resistant packaging and stored as recommended. The expiry date appears on the product label and the agreed specification sheet. In practice, shelf-life performance depends on keeping packs intact, controlling humidity and temperature, limiting light exposure and following good warehouse practice.

MOQ, Lead Times, Samples, and Quotations

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for dehydrated coriander leaves powder? Our MOQ is 5 Kg for standard bulk supply. Private label work, printed packaging, special grading and OEM orders may need a larger quantity so that procurement and production runs stay efficient. We confirm the final quantity after reviewing your volume, packaging style, destination and specification. Lead time depends on specification approval, order confirmation, packaging sign-off and the agreed payment terms. Ready stock can usually move faster, while customised or private label orders take longer. We confirm the timeline in each quotation. To request a sample or quote, please send your volume, packaging preference, destination country, intended application, documentation needs and target delivery window. Our sales team will review it and come back with practical guidance.

Storage and Handling Guidelines

Store the product in a cool, dry, clean and well-ventilated warehouse, away from direct sunlight, heat sources, strong odours and chemicals. Reseal packs tightly after opening and use clean, dry scoops. Avoid high humidity, because moisture pick-up can cause caking, aroma loss, discolouration and a shorter shelf life.

Tradenest Naturals offers B2B buyers more than a product listing. As a coriander leaves powder manufacturer, wholesale supplier and export partner, we help customers choose the right specification, pack size, labelling format and supply plan. Our capabilities cover dehydration, milling, sieving, blending, private label retail packing, formulation support and export documentation. We put clear communication, consistent quality, quick sampling and long-term relationships first. Contact Tradenest Naturals to discuss your wholesale dehydrated coriander leaves powder requirements, private label needs, repeat supply contracts or custom ingredient development for your market.
